was: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) along Asaph Run near Gaines. 10 sites with picnic tables, fire rings and non-flush toilets; four of them list a 30-ft max vehicle length, the rest 25 ft or less. No hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024; on-site honor registration has ended). --Claude
note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) along Asaph Run near Gaines. 10 sites with picnic tables and fire rings. --Claude

was: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) near Grover, along a small stream. 15 pull-in sites, twelve of them listed for vehicles up to 40 ft; non-flush toilets, no hookups, water or dump station. Must be reserved through the PA reservation system (since January 2024).
note: Developed drive-in state forest campground (Tioga State Forest) near Grover, along a small stream.

was: Breaks Interstate Park, run by the VA-KY Breaks Interstate Park Commission (developed area is on the Virginia side). 138 drive-in sites in loops A-D: primitive, electric+water, and full-hookup; paved loops. Reservable (Firefly); full campground Apr 1-Oct 31, Loop D open off-season. Loops sit on the wooded plateau, not on the water (the Laurel Lake lakefront accommodations are separate cabins). --Claude

was: Franklin County Parks & Recreation campground on Corps of Engineers land at Philpott Lake, near Henry. Wooded lakeside setting with a non-motorized boat ramp and hiking trails; the electric sites sit beside the bathhouse, the overflow sites away from it. Cell reception is extremely weak. --Claude

was: City of Buena Vista park (Glen Maury Park) on the Maury River. Lower campground: open grassy RV/tent sites without gravel pads (Rally Field, Riverside, The Island, Water's Edge), water and electric, no sewer, bath house and dump station. Upper campground: wooded gravel-pad sites at Hill Top and Oak Ridge, many full hookup, not recommended for rigs over 32 ft. Electric is 30 or 50 amp. Reservations by phone (540-261-7321); walk-ups may ask about availability on arrival. Campers may be asked to pay admission or move during city events. --Claude
note: City of Buena Vista park (Glen Maury Park) on the Maury River. Lower campground: bath house and dump station. Electric is 30 or 50 amp. Campers may be asked to pay admission or move during city events. --Claude

was: City of Bristol park (~400 acres) along Beaver Creek. 75 electric (30/50-amp) sites, no tent camping (except Rhythm & Roots weekend), no cabins. Pay at entrance booth. Creekside trail; the mapped 'Beaver Creek Lake' is a TVA dry flood basin, not a standing lake. --Claude

was: Washington County Park Authority park on South Holston Lake (lake is TVA, park is county-run). About 140 full-hookup (30/50-amp) RV sites, campers up to 42 ft, plus tent sites, 7 shelters, swimming beach, 2 boat launches; showers, laundromat, Wi-Fi. Open April 1 to October 31. Book online through the Park Authority's Firefly reservation page or the front booth; seasonal sites go by waiting list. The campground fills a narrow lake peninsula - outer-loop full-hookup RV sites back directly onto the lake (some with docks); inner sites have lake views. --Claude

was: Chester County park (1,000+ acres) near Coatesville PA. RV-capable at the 19 Fiddler's Campground sites, which the county says take tents, small camp trailers and RVs (access depths 25-60 ft); the 20 Lake Campground sites are tent-only. No hookups, no dump station. Reservations online/phone or first-come self-registration; open weekends April through the second full weekend in November. Chambers Lake and Brandywine Creek are in the park but the RV-capable sites are wooded/inland. --Claude

was: Bradford County park atop Barclay Mountain around 30-acre Sunfish Pond, near Canton PA (Leroy Twp). 38 electric-only RV sites plus about a dozen tent sites and primitive cabins; dump station, showers, camp store. Seasonal: May 9 - October 11 in 2026. A few RV sites sit along the pond. Park supervisor 570-250-5414. --Claude
note: Bradford County park atop Barclay Mountain around 30-acre Sunfish Pond, near Canton PA (Leroy Twp). A few RV sites sit along the pond. Park supervisor 570-250-5414. --Claude

was: Venango County park (2,695 acres) on 144-acre Justus Lake near Franklin PA. Drive-in RV camping: 12 full-hookup + 28 electric sites (30/50-amp), modern showers, camp host. The lakeside 'water's edge' sites (loops E/F) are walk-in/primitive tent sites; the RV loops are set back east of the lake, so waterfront none. Reservations via the park office. --Claude

was: Private campground at 130 Wilson Rd near Wellsboro (Tioga Co), on the East Rim of the PA Grand Canyon with a trail from the campground to the overlook level at Leonard Harrison State Park; close to the Pine Creek Rail Trail. Wooded sites with electric, electric/water and full hookups for rigs up to a 45-ft motorhome, plus primitive tent sites and glamping cabins; bath house with flush toilets and showers, laundry, store, dump station. Open April 15 - October 31; book online or by phone up to a year ahead. A $20 management fee per stay. --Claude

No on-site water body. --Claude  Reservations by phone only (724-668-8589); no online booking — Hipcamp listing is "coming soon"/unbookable. was: Small private full-hookup RV park (10 sites) near Cambridge Springs (Crawford Co), sitting just above 30-acre Mitchell Lake. 20/30/50-amp, water and sewer at every site; grass pads up to 50 ft, several pull-through. Daily/weekly/monthly, no tents, no restrooms or showers, laundromat; open May 1-Oct 31. Sites overlook the lake from above (not on the shoreline). Phone 814-398-2652. --Claude

was: Private family campground (54 wooded acres) near Titusville (Crawford Co); set back from Oil Creek itself. Big-rig friendly pull-throughs, 20/30/50-amp, water/electric and full-hookup sites. Not waterfront. Reservations by phone only (814-807-8005); no online booking system. --Claude

was: Christian camp near Susquehanna (Susquehanna Co) that runs a public family campground open to all (online nightly booking). Water/electric sites (20/30 amp on some, 20 amp on the rest), five with sewer; RVs to 40 ft on seven sites, most others 27-30 ft. Open May 15-Oct 12 in 2026, closed to campers July 19-31 for youth camps. Note: no-alcohol and conduct standards apply. On-site lake (RV sites not on it). --Claude

was: 115 acres, 5 lakes; mostly seasonal, with designated nightly and weekend lots. --Claude

Mostly permanent (seasonal) sites and two club areas, with weekend sites for overnight campers. Big-rig friendly, 13-acre fishing lake, indoor pool. Campers and trailers only (no tents). Family-owned since 1979. --Claude

was: Most sites are seasonal; overnight campers get the water/electric rows and a few full-hookup sites. Sites 200-208 are grassy 'Creekside View' sites along Brokensword Creek. --Claude

Family campground off Apollo Rd SE outside Carrollton, with a pool, stocked fishing pond and rec room (Google reviews).
